name: BonkCity
summary: BonkCity is a 90s hip-hop horde survivor roguelike. Playing as an MC defending your block, you survive waves of posers, record label security, and label muscle across a procedurally chaotic back-alley night. Move and auto-attack while drafting weapons and perks from level-up cards, evolve maxed weapons into powerful combos, and earn "drip" — cosmetic gear that stacks into real stats. Each run climbs toward a three-phase showdown with the Industry Plant, a manufactured fake MC built to replace the cypher. Features a shared Daily Block seed with leaderboards, four playable characters (more to come), and challenge modifiers called Beefs. Built solo in Godot, drawing DNA from Vampire Survivors and Brotato with the color and soul of Jet Set Radio and Streets of Rage.
